entries.title: Question 2: provisions effective on certification of the vote (Charter 20-t, 325(a))
entries.citation: Charter 20-t (subdivision d amended, subdivision h added, section renumbered 20-v) and 325(a); effective-date clause Charter 1152(q)(2); Question 2 of the 2026-11-03 ballot
entries.summary: Question 2 amends Charter 20-t(d), adds 20-t(h), renumbers 20-t as 20-v and amends 325(a) (client services plan and schedule). Per the proposed text these take effect immediately upon certification that the electors approved them. The text does not amend Administrative Code 6-129.

entries.title: Question 2: Procurement Policy Board meets at least quarterly (Charter 311(a)), effective 2027-01-01

entries.title: PPB proposed rule: replace HHS Accelerator references and add HHS procurement timeframes (9 RCNY 3-16 and others)
entries.citation: 9 RCNY 1-01(e), 2-04, 2-08, 2-09, 3-01, 3-03, 3-10, 3-16 (repealed and replaced) and 4-12; Amendment of PPB Rules Relating to HHS Accelerator
entries.summary: The Procurement Policy Board proposes to remove HHS Accelerator references, repeal and replace 3-16 as HHS Procurements (client services through an HHS prequalified list under 3-10) and add procurement timeframes under Local Law 169 of 2023. The NYC Rules page still lists it as proposed; the hearing was 2025-11-17 and comments are closed.

entries.title: NY Senate bill S267 (2025-2026): reciprocal City-State M/WBE certification
entries.citation: NY Senate Bill 2025-S267, an act to amend the executive law, in relation to reciprocal minority and women-owned business enterprise certification; Assembly substitute A8294
entries.summary: Authorizes the state director of minority and women's business development and the New York City mayor to enter a memorandum of understanding for reciprocal acceptance of M/WBE certification. Passed the Senate 2026-05-28 and the Assembly 2026-06-04 (substituted for A8294). No governor action appears in the action history.
